# Vendored header-only dependencies

- cpp-httplib v0.51.0: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.51.0 — `httplib.h`, MIT license in `httplib.LICENSE`.
- nlohmann/json v3.12.0: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0 — `json.hpp`, MIT license in `json.LICENSE`.

The IBKR C++ SDK is an external, already installed dependency; it is not vendored here.
